task: Independent review of fresh-run-advance failure handling; no source edits or capture-root interaction.

findings.finding: No test in tools/test_frozen_baseline.py invokes advance_fresh_run or exercises fresh-run-advance failure end-to-end. Existing assertions validate CLI argument shape (test_fresh_advance_cli_is_capture_replay_only_and_bounded), journal structure/authentication (test_fresh_run_journal_requires_ordered_authenticated_nonzero_complete_prefix), immutable append helper, and source/plan metadata. They do not inject a failed child/timeout/artifact mutation through the command and inspect ordinal/evidence.

findings.severity: possible retry deadlock exposed by required regression
findings.finding: advance_fresh_run renames stage to final_chunk and sets stage=None before _verify_fresh_journal_artifacts and _fresh_journal_append. If either post-rename operation fails (e.g. expected artifact mutates after its recorded digest), except no longer writes untrusted-failure.json, an unreceipted final chunk remains, and a retry rejects it at final_chunk.exists() with "chunk output already exists without a matching journal receipt". Thus no success receipt/ordinal advances, but retryability and failure evidence are not preserved. Verify artifacts before publication; publish chunk+receipt with rollback/atomic recovery semantics, and write failure evidence into retained staging on failed validation.

smallest_test_plan: Add a reusable temporary fresh-run fixture with one capture chunk and authenticated manifest/key/plan. Invoke actual advance_fresh_run (or parsed CLI main dispatch) with production run_live_chunk; patch only expensive trust boundaries (frozen-source/binary identity verification and extension inventory) and point PATH at a temporary fake cargo executable.

Child nonzero case: fake cargo writes stdout/stderr then exits nonzero. Assert advance raises; no journal step file, no final chunk, no JSON success output; ordinal remains 0 on a subsequent attempt; retained .attempt directory includes runner report/logs plus untrusted-failure.json and hashes remain inspectable.
Timeout case: fake cargo sleeps beyond run timeout. Assert actual subprocess timeout cleanup and same no-success/no-advance/evidence assertions; bound test to a short timeout.

Mutation case: have a success-shaped run_live_chunk fixture create expected artifact tree, then mutate one captured file after expected_chunk_sha256 is computed but before artifact verification/publication. Assert failure, no journal receipt/no success output, unchanged ordinal, and retained failed evidence. This regression should currently reveal the rename-before-verify orphan/retry deadlock; require implementation fix before expecting a green test.
Run test twice from a fresh temporary root to confirm deterministic ordinal/evidence assertions. Keep no artifacts under repository or immutable reference roots.
existing_unit_vs_executed_failure: At inspected commits, audit states 70 unittest tests passed and one live successful 32-case Holla capture ran. Those are not failure-injection evidence. This review did not execute failure tests; no claim of real failed child/timeout/mutation detection is made.
